scientific_integrity: Homotopy proof uses an exhaustive, explicit acyclic Morse matching; finite computations are not generalized to other graphs.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 12-vertex Bidiakis graph, not an infinite family.
H1 D4 decomposition is rational, not an integral irreducible-lattice splitting.
No equivariant homotopy sphere model is claimed.
Originality relative to inspected literature; independent validation absent.
title: The integral graph-metric Rips filtration and dihedral homology of the Bidiakis cube
